LanguageData.CC_Region_Button_Tip: Opens a map of the land around the colony in a window of its own, over the colony rather than in the game's world view: the settlements nearby, their people, and how far each is by caravan. The window can be moved and resized and stays open while the game runs.
LanguageData.CC_Region_Reach_Tip: How far the map reaches from the colony, in tiles each way. A wider map shows more settlements, a narrower one is drawn finer. Kept in Rimfolk's settings.
LanguageData.CC_Region_Home_Tip: Moves the map back so the colony is in the middle.
LanguageData.CC_Region_ZoomIn: Zoom in (or turn the mouse wheel over the map)
LanguageData.CC_Region_NoHome: There is no colony on the planet's surface to centre the map on.
LanguageData.CC_Region_Failed: The map couldn't be drawn. The log says why.
LanguageData.CC_Region_PickHint: Click a settlement to see it here, or any tile to see the land. Turn the mouse wheel to zoom, and drag the map to look around. Hover over a tile for its land and climate.
LanguageData.CC_Region_ClickTip: Click to see it beside the map.
LanguageData.CC_Region_ShowOnWorld_Tip: Switches to the game's world view with this picked there. The region map stays open.
LanguageData.CC_Region_NoWay: No way there over land, {0} tiles away.
LanguageData.CC_Region_Climate: Mean temperature {0}, {1} mm of rain a year
LanguageData.CC_Region_Remember: What they remember of the colony: {0}
LanguageData.CC_Region_Std_Fair: On fair terms with the colony (goodwill {0})
LanguageData.CC_Region_Std_Enemies: Enemies of everyone, never at peace
LanguageData.CC_Settings_RegionMapRadius_Tip: How far the region map reaches from the colony, in tiles each way. A wider map shows more settlements, a narrower one is drawn finer. The map's window has the same control at its top.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_RegionMapRadius: The region map (the button on the council's World page) shows the land this many tiles each way from the colony.
